intentions.title: Guarantee the canvas editor's blocks⇄TipTap-doc⇄ops projector never silently corrupts a PortableDoc on save
intentions.evidence: harness.mjs implements applyOps, a pure-JS twin of api/lib/barkpark/portable_doc/patch.ex, and assertFolds proves every emitted op list actually folds prev blocks into the live doc — round-trip.mjs's comment explains this was added after two real bugs (front-insert landing at END; an insert stranded by a later move) passed shape-only assertions. Every check pairs op-shape assertions with a fold gate.

intentions.title: Make every canvas-eligible block type (prose, lists, marks, wikilinks, blockrefs, tags, valuerefs, dividers, callouts, code, diagrams, native fields, sections) round-trip byte-identically through the editor with zero spurious ops on load
intentions.evidence: round-trip.mjs's 17 numbered checks + S0-a..k projector gates, node-views.mjs's S3/S3.2/S3.3/S3.4 sections (divider/callout/code/diagram), sections.mjs's S2 layout-engine tests — each pins 'untouched → ZERO ops' plus 'edit → exactly one minimal op (patch-block, not replace-block)'.

intentions.title: Support nested container blocks (sections with grid/stack layout, span/order-positioned children) while forbidding recursive nesting and preventing id collisions across the whole tree
intentions.evidence: sections.mjs: bpSection projection, V1 forbid-nesting (nested sections carried as bpOpaque verbatim), the 'duplicate_id guard' test proving minted ids are seeded from the WHOLE tree including nested children, and the S2 grid-layout suite (mode toggle, span/order hoisted to a bpId-keyed cells map that survives reordering — the regression test for span/order sticking to the wrong child).

intentions.title: Ship a slash-menu and Cmd-P command palette where every insertable block type produces byte-identical default content via both paths
intentions.evidence: autocomplete-slash.mjs: CANVAS_SLASH_TYPES allowlist (22 types), reconstructDefault() proving canonical default shapes for paragraph/heading/list/callout/code/divider/diagram/action/figure/columns/section/terminal/table/field-*, the callout-shorthand (`> [!warn]-`) parser, slashTriggerAllowsParent's Bug#2 guard against destroying an enclosing callout, and P5 palette tests proving Insert-command parity with slash-menu defaults plus a working fuzzy filter.

intentions.title: Preserve inline live-references (wikilinks with alias/docId, task-chip wikilinks, valuerefs with reserved as/label passthrough) across edits to neighboring text without ever deleting or flattening them
intentions.evidence: round-trip.mjs checks 9-13, 12v/12w/12x, S0-v1/S0-v2: explicit regression tests documenting a pre-fix defect where the whole-content rewrite on save deleted valuerefs, and where wikilinks/blockrefs/tags lost their target/alias/docId keys or gained stray undefined keys.

intentions.title: Keep change-detection robust to editor-serialization noise (ProseMirror getJSON key ordering) so no block is spuriously re-patched on every keystroke
intentions.evidence: S0-mark check in round-trip.mjs and reordered-attrs checks throughout node-views.mjs (S3.2-b, S3.3-b, S3.4-b) simulate getJSON's {type,marks,text} / reordered attrs key order and assert ZERO ops on an unedited mount despite the reordering.

intentions.title: Defensively tolerate legacy/malformed stored data (flat-string list items) without crashing either editor, while normalizing it to the canonical shape on save
intentions.evidence: round-trip.mjs checks 4a/4b and the S0 flat-string-item checks: documented as 'the obsidian crash shape' — 7 real legacy papers had items as flat strings and inlineArrayToTiptap would throw calling .forEach on a string, crashing both editors on open.
